---
title: Exports
description: Get submissions out as CSV, GeoJSON or Parquet.
---

An export is a snapshot of a survey's submissions in one file. Exports run in the background and are kept for the retention period of your plan.

## Formats

- **CSV** — one row per submission, one column per question across every version
- **GeoJSON** — one feature per submission with a `location` answer
- **Parquet** — typed columns; the best choice for anything over a million rows

## Starting an Export

```python
export = fk.exports.create(survey="soil-samples", format="parquet", since="2025-06-01")
export.wait()
export.download("soil-samples.parquet")
```

```bash
fieldkit exports create soil-samples --format csv --since 2025-06-01 --wait
```

## Columns

Every export carries these columns before the survey's own:

| Column | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| `submission_id` | Stable id of the submission |
| `survey_version` | The version the submission answered |
| `device_id` | The device it came from |
| `device_time` | When it was submitted, by the device clock |
| `received_at` | When it reached Fieldkit |
| `revises` | The submission this one revises, if any |
